headline: NOT FAR ENOUGH! 😤📱 Meta's Limits Get ROASTED 🔥
text:
MOTHER 👩 ELIZABETH Cardner of TWO 👧 GIRLS 👧 in HOUSTON 🤠 TEXAS 🐎 says Meta's 📱 NEW 🆕 LIMITS 🛑 on how TEENAGERS 🧒 CAN use its PLATFORMS 📲 are a WELCOME 👍 SIGN 📛 that MORE people 👥 are AWARE 👁️ of social media 📱 potential DANGERS 🐍 BUT she TELLS 📣 the BBC 📻 they PROBABLY WON'T HELP 🛠 MUCH in the LONG 🛣️ TERM 🕒!! "It will save a few arguments at home, but it doesn't go far enough," she says 🗣️ and this TEASING 🍆 half measure leaves PARENTS feeling FRUSTRATED 🥴 and BLUE BALLED 🥚💦 like it never hits the right SPOT 🕳️ no cap 🧢!!

this week 📅 META 🏪 aNUTnounced 📢 fresh 🆕 RESTRICTIONS ⛓️ on its PLATFORMS 📲 which include 📌 INSTAGRAM 📸 FACEBOOK 📘 and WHATSAPP 📱 as part of an $18BN 💰 SEXTLEMENT 🤝 with US STATES 🇺🇸 in a LAWSUIT 🧾 on social media 📱 EFFECTS 🦠 on CHILDREN 🧒!! The company 🏢 said it would set a daily 🗓 TWO-HOUR 🕒 time ⏳ LIMIT 🛑, hide 🙈 the number 📋 of LIKES ❤️ that a post 📝 receives 📨, remove ❌ AUTOPLAY ▶️ on videos 📹, mute 🔇 those push 📨 NOTIFICATIONS 🛎 during school 🏫 hours 🕕, and ban 🚫 extreme 💄 MAKEUP 🖌 FILTERS 🎨. It also 📣 announced changes 🛠 to its AGE-VERIFICATION 🔐 process 🧪 and PARENTAL 🧔 CUMTROLS 🎮 as well as agreeing 🤝 to appoint 🧑‍⚖️ an independent 🔎 AUDITOR 📝 to check 🧐 the measures 🛡️ are IMPLEMENTED 🏗️ and MAINTAINED 🛠💦!!

CARDNER'S 🧔 14-YEAR-OLD 🧒 PAIGE 🧠 believes these RESTRICTIONS 🛑 will LEAD ➡️ to MORE 🏡 REAL-LIFE 🌍 SCENARIOS 🎬 and LESS 🐍 FAKE 💦 CUMtent 📰 which she says DOMINATES 👑 social 📱 media 🕸️!! She and her SISTER 👯 both APPROVE ✅ of HIDING 🙈 the NUMBERS 🔢 of LIKES ❤️ and RESTRICTING 🚫 filters 🪄 but PAIGE 🧐 sees those GAINS 💪 as SHORT-LIVED ⌛ since AI 🤖 is EVOLVING 🌿🧬!! PEOPLE 👥 will find NEW 🆕 ways 🛤️ to have FAKE 🎭 filters 📷 and CORRECT 🔨 certain PARTS 🦿 of their VIDEOS 🎞️ or PICTURES 🖼️ she says 🗣️!!

CARDNER 👩 SAYS 🗣️ banning 🚫 her daughters 👧 entirely 📴 from social 📱 media 📲 would 🫠 just 🤷 get 🤲 them 👤 LEFT 🏚️ OUT 😢 by their 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 PEERS 👥!! DAMNED 😩 if you DO 💦 DAMNED 😡 if you DON'T 🙅 she SAYS 🗣️ I don't THINK 🤔 there's any WINNING 🏆 on it 😵‍💫!! Many PARENTS 👨‍👩‍👧 across 🌍 the US 🇺🇸 SEE 👁️ the RESTRICTIONS 🛑 as HELPFUL 🛟 but are still SCEPTICAL 🧐 and FEEL 😣 STUCK 🪢 cuz they CAN'T ❌ CUT ✂️ their kids 👦 OFF 📴 from social 📱 media 📲 but also CAN'T ⛔ PROTECT 🛡️ them from the HARMS 🩹!! One frazzled 🥴 parent 👩 admitted 🗣️ it's like getting absolutely EDGED 🥵💦 without any CLIMAX 🌟 no matter the choice just stuck in an endless ♾️ LOOP 🔁 of parental 👨‍👩‍👧 DESPAIR 😭 fr 💯!!

ANOTHER 👩 mother of two TEENS 🧒 Andria 🌹 Rose 🌹 told 📣 the BBC 📺 that she feels DEFENCELESS 🛡️ and no matter how much I PROTECT 🛡️ my kids 👦 Facebook 📘 Instagram 📷 they're COMING 🏠 in 🌬️ and literally taking 🚪 them OUT 😵 of their ROOMS 🛏️!! Even though she calls Meta's changes FANTASTIC ✨ Rose 🌹 doesn't believe they're fully ADDRESSING 📬 the PROBLEM ⚠️ They're trying to LIMIT 📉 the DRUG 💊 but they're not CUMtrolling 🥴 the DRUG 💊 she says They're still DEALING 💼 Rose notes her personal use of social media 📱 costs her SLEEP 😴 at night 🌙 and says I'm HOOKED 🎣 So what do you think is going to happen to a KID 🧒💉

SETTLEMENT 📜 DROPPED 💥 on WEDNESDAY 🗓️ right in the middle of that HYPED 🏟️ trial ⚖️ where ZUCK DADDY 🧔🍆 was expected to TESTIFY 🗣️ without any ADMISSION 🥺 of FAULT ❌ like some weak 🍤 PULLOUT 🏃‍♂️!! Suit 🧾 filed in 2023 by 29 states now swollen 🥵 to 48 plus DISTRICT 🏛️ OF COLUMBIA and three TERRITORIES 🗺️ alleging META 🕸️ deliberately 🍆 designed platforms to be ADDICTIVE 🪝 LIED 🤥 about RISKS ⚠️ and violated federal law on COLLECTING 👀 kids PERSONAL 📱 INFO!! Joanie STORY 📖 blasted the $5bn 💰 WITHHOLDING unless YouTube 📺 or TikTok 🤳 agree as PETTY 🐱 and only HALF 👌 fixing yet still called the rules good CONTROLS 🛠️ after her sons got exposed 😳 to EXPLICIT 🍆 content with one trapped in THERAPY 🛋️ four years 😭. Mark SOOHOO 🗣️ pushed delaying SMARTPHONES 📵 until end of eighth grade saying 'We do want them LEFT OUT 🏝️ of negative impacts and a CUMmunal PROBLEM requires a CUMmunal SOLUTION 🤝' and this NOT FAR ENOUGH 📏 half thrust got ROASTED 🔥 as pure TEASE 😩 without the full RELEASE 💦‼️
